detail.longDescription: # GCP : A comment on a single public # GitHub repo issue (gemini-cli 100k+ stars) was enough for an unauthenticated attacker to take over a Google Cloud project abusing Workload Identity Federation(WIF) in exploit chain - great research from @Pillar_sec : 👇 https://www. pillar.security/blog/a-wif-of- fresh-access-how-a-github-issue-on-gemini-cli-led-to-gcp-project-compromise
